pages.text: Storage upgrades increase the capacity of drawers, with higher-tier upgrades adding more space.$(br2)If multiple storage upgrades are placed, their storage multipliers are added together.
Obsidian upgrades increase storage by 2x the base amount.$(br2)Obsidian upgrades also give drawers blast resistance.
Copper upgrades increase storage by 4x the base amount.
Iron upgrades increase storage by 8x the base amount.
Gold upgrades increase storage by 16x the base amount.
Emerald upgrades increase storage by 64x the base amount.
Diamond upgrades increase storage by 256x the base amount.
Netherite upgrades increase storage by 2048x the base amount.
